6.73 rsInvalidDetailsDataGrouping
rsInvalidDetailsDataGrouping is a critical error that will occur if a details data region member contains
an inner data region member. For example, this error will occur if a TablixMember has no
TablixMember.Group element specified, and it contains a TablixMember.TablixMembers child element.
